Execute the Vietnam thermal generation inventory in phases. TURN 1 — COAL PLANTS DISCOVERY: Search for Vietnam's coal-fired power plants systematically. Cover: (a) currently operating coal plants, (b) plants under construction, (c) planned/announced coal plants per PDP8, (d) cancelled/shelved coal projects. For each, capture: Vietnamese name, English name, province, technology (subcritical/supercritical/USC), unit configuration, total MWe, status, COD, owner/developer. Use the evidence pack (PDP7, PDP7A, PDP8 annexes, EVN ARs) as the backbone and supplement with targeted web searches. Compile a working list with source annotations. TURN 2 — GAS & LNG PLANTS DISCOVERY: Search for Vietnam's gas-fired and LNG-to-power plants. Cover: (a) operating domestic-gas plants (Phú Mỹ complex, Cà Mau, Nhơn Trạch, etc.), (b) LNG-to-power projects (Nhơn Trạch 3&4, Bạc Liêu, Sơn Mỹ, Long An, Quảng Ninh, Hải Lăng, etc.), (c) cancelled/shelved gas projects. Capture same attributes. Cross-reference PDP8 Annex II tables for planned gas/LNG capacity. TURN 3 — REPORT COMPILATION: Produce the final Markdown inventory document. Begin directly with the single pipe table (all assets, all fuels, all statuses in one table). Follow with per-asset notes for major/disputed/ambiguous assets. End with annotated bibliography. Apply confidence rules strictly. Reconcile any conflicts found in Turns 1-2. Ensure arithmetic consistency (Units×MW = Total MWe or explain). Flag temporal freshness issues. TURN 4 — VERIFY & POLISH: Review the report for: (a) missing known assets, (b) arithmetic errors, (c) confidence miscalibration, (d) source gaps, (e) status/date consistency.
